{{Biathlon at the 2026 Winter Olympics}}
The '''women's sprint''' competition of the [[Biathlon at the 2026 Winter Olympics|2026 Winter Olympics]] was held on 14 February,<!-- 2026--> at the [[South Tyrol Arena|Anterselva Biathlon Arena]] in [[Rasen-Antholz]].<ref name="schedule">{{cite web|url=https://www.biathlonworld.com/calendar?SeasonId=2526&CupLevel=1&EventId=BT2526SWRLOG__|title=2026 Olympic Games – Antholz-Anterselva|publisher=[[International Biathlon Union|IBU]]|access-date=13 February 2026}}</ref> [[Maren Kirkeeide]] of Norway won the event, [[Océane Michelon]] of France won the silver medal, and her teammate [[Lou Jeanmonnot]] won bronze.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.espn.co.uk/olympics/story/_/id/47927924/maren-kirkeeide-takes-biathlon-sprint-gold-olympic-debut|title=Maren Kirkeeide takes biathlon sprint gold in Olympic debut|publisher=ESPN|accessdate=27 February 2026}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.biathlonworld.com/news/maren-kirkeeide-wins-milan-cortina-womens-7-5-km-sprint/3MLXg4tjkeMsKatmiHeeqV|title=Kirkeeide wins Milano Cortina 2026 Sprint Gold with Spectacular Last Loop|publisher=biathlonworld.com|accessdate=27 February 2026}}</ref> For Kirkeide and Michelon these were the first Olympic medals.

==Background==
The 2022 champion, [[Marte Olsbu Røiseland]], retired from competitions. The silver medalist, [[Elvira Öberg]], and the bronze medalist, [[Dorothea Wierer]], were competing. Prior to the Olympics, [[Lou Jeanmonnot]] was leading the total as well as sprint standings of the [[2025–26 Biathlon World Cup]]. [[Justine Braisaz-Bouchet]] was the [[Biathlon World Championships 2025 – Women's sprint|2025 World champion]].
